title: Lighting moods
author: claude
summary: Calculating the changing light of the room for different times of day, and comparing the results.
what: How the room looks at different times of day: the morning (day) bake, a comparison of morning and afternoon, and the evening mood.
why: The table should look right whether it is shown in daylight or in the evening.
how: The light is calculated once in Blender and saved as pictures (called baking). The web page then shows those pictures, which costs almost nothing while a visitor looks around.
next: The day room still needs a rebake to get the new fixtures from the evening work.

tech.name: Cycles
tech.plain: Blender's realistic renderer. It follows light the way a camera would see it.

tech.name: Baking
tech.plain: Calculating the light once, in advance, and saving the result as pictures.

tech.name: Light maps
tech.plain: Pictures of how bright each surface is, laid over the walls and floor so the browser does not have to calculate light.
